why_decline: The English queries are unnecessarily rewritten and expanded before retrieval. Different words change both sparse and dense scores.
Source evidence does not always include its service heading within the same chunk. Similar actions from other services compete.
A prompt can improve output format without improving evidence ranking. This candidate was not promoted.

rank_evidence.change: washing of hogs -> service related to hog washing
Rephrased question and added office name
what happens -> what is the process, plus expanded acronyms
A gain on one query does not offset the broader regression

context_observations: OCBO page14 C002 contains step2.1/2.4 and time pairs without Occupancy Permit wording.
CPDO page11 service heading is in C001; eligibility facts in C002.
BB page16 contains both earlier checklist and renewal; lexical same-page matches require row/stage verification.
causal_limit: Controlled comparison isolates query-string effect on fixed retrieval. Absence of a service heading is observed but its causal effect has not been separately tested.
rag_stages: Existing app supports normalization -> hybrid chunk retrieval -> context assembly -> grounded Mistral generation. These runs deliberately evaluate retrieval only, not generated-answer accuracy.
next_changes_to_review: First establish a normalization fidelity suite including English preservation, multilingual translations, office/action/stage/height/condition retention, contamination and truncation.
Do not promote the current normalization candidate on these results. Do not silently bypass the manuscript LLM translation stage.

Then test a separately versioned source-context preprocessing candidate, explicitly documented against Chapter3, retaining 120/20 chunks and chunk-level scoring; no section retrieval or service-specific hardcoded boosts.
manual_review: No new user action needed for this diagnosis. Before formal reporting, an independent bilingual reviewer should validate multilingual normalization labels; BB renewal row association still needs semantic review.
no_changes_to: Corpus, indices, weights, app artifact defaults, dictionary and benchmarks.
